# Translations for `tracy-business/j6` **1.2.4**

Copied byte for byte from [`../1.2.3/`](../1.2.3/README.md) (`MANIFEST.sha256` unchanged and still matching).

Why a copy is right: 1.2.4 is 1.2.3 with the template's stylesheets reading the standard role variables at
the source (tracy-ds-slot `release-joomla.mjs --overlay`, 16/10/2026, feat/ds-role-variables) and four demo
pictures trimmed. The database asset is the same bytes as 1.2.3's and the content map differs only in
`requiresEvidence` raised on its fact fields (`scripts/regate-contract.mjs`), so no field was added, removed
or renamed and the translations joined by key keep their meaning.
